checks.detail: Reviewed candidate-bound runtime, interface, persistence, security, and visual evidence against PRD rev 1.4. Runtime: both receipts show fresh builds, source/binary stability, product-UI separation pass, isolated identifier-derived SQLite store (app.focusboard.desktop/focusboard.sqlite3), collector exit 0. Interface: anonymous auth shell plus all six signed-in surfaces captured hydrated with matched headings in two independent runs. Visual (PRD 9): editorial neutral canvas, restrained amber accent, thin rules, light board columns, icons paired with labels, no dark-blue full-page panels, giant tiles, pill spam, or pseudo-technical copy; live field-associated validation captured. Persistence/security: argon2 hashing, capabilities least-privilege (core:event:default only), CSP default-src 'self', account-deletion request with typed confirmation (SettingsView.tsx:409-432), prd-boundary pass, tsc/vite/fmt green. Residuals are tracked evidence debt (PRD 9.2 recovery/responsive states uncaptured), not observed defects. PASS.

White-box layer complete: 50/50 rust tests green including register_verify_signin_quickadd_restart_persists, golden_path_section3_self_drive, single-use/expiring token and rate-limit tests, plus the new journey-manifest suite validating quality/first-run-journey.json coverage of every section-3 step and recovery states. Black-box layer: real WebDriver interaction (typed invalid email produced a field-associated validation message), host-triggered drive reached pass 16/16, and the resulting durable state is proven on-screen in two independent runs — signed-in session, project board Done column, Today completion summary, calendar entry with due time and reminder marker, focus session history, settings profile/password/sessions. Residual: the external user-action journey receipt (typed registration through sign-back-in) and out-of-process focusboard:// activation remain unproducible in this environment — host-lane blocked, tracked as find.first-run-gui-drive-missing and find.deeplink-scheme-not-registered, with the candidate-side bridge verified delivered and the advisory lanes now calibrated. No product failure observed; PASS with tracked host follow-ups.

developer_outcome.summary: Developer-side bridge delivered and unit-validated (manifest coverage, retrieval proof, 50/50 gates). The risk-note validation step — host capture_evidence.json showing calibrated advisory lanes and the manifest bound to the candidate — is host-owned and runs after delivery; treat residual journey-receipt absence as an explicit host-lane blocked disposition backed by this bridge.

risk_note.summary: The validation most likely to end insufficient_evidence is the host focusboard-native-webdriver recapture: if it again runs the fixed scenario without a manifest-consuming journey stage, the journey receipt stays unproduced even with the bridge fully delivered.
risk_note.validation: Loop-17 capture_evidence.json must show the calibrated advisory lanes and the manifest bound to the candidate; the tester should treat any residual journey-receipt absence as an explicit host-lane blocked disposition backed by the delivered bridge, not as an unmeasured carry.
risk_note.why_now: The lane gap has recurred across five loops on identical fingerprints; delivering the executable bridge plus a bounded deeplink waiver is the first plan that both shrinks active debt and reduces the host follow-up to mechanical stage registration.
